propositions: tolerant_parse returns the first parseable JSON object in a reply, causing schema-valid decoy material (tool results, examples, dependency records) to be extracted instead of the real payload
The schema-blind extraction defect recurs across model swaps and provider cutover events, defeating prior instance-specific fixes
Prompted structured-output replies need schema-filtered candidate selection with last-valid-wins logic to distinguish the legitimate payload from quoted examples
Provider-native structured output can be safely enabled only for models measured to support it; unmeasured or failing models must remain on the hardened prompted path
An explicit sentinel output channel and extraction mechanism must ship together to reliably signal the real payload and prevent decoy matches
A replayable raw-reply artifact capability is needed for parse-failure diagnosis and must remain optional to avoid data leakage
